parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against human nuclear receptor ROR-γ (CHEMBL1741186) where the assay organism is human. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary to filter by target ChEMBL ID. Join compound_structures as an inner join to require structures. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
